## Progress

- Added [InvariantQuotientCrossChartCompat.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/InvariantQuotientCrossChartCompat.lean) and imported it from [MilneLib.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib.lean).
- Proved basic-open transport, quotient-open transport, restricted-map naturality, and `affineInvariantQuotient_basicOpen_crossChart`.
- Committed as `841890b05cb0d558b7c82c8f017ebf285985868c` (`Milne: compare invariant quotient charts across coordinates`).
- Verified the focused module, `MilneLib` umbrella, and full `2701/2701` build. Axiom checks report only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms.
- Synced hgraph (`stale=0`) and pinned the finite-quotient roadmap item to the commit. No blueprint files were changed.
- Ran `honesty-reviewer`; its scope warning was incorporated into the theorem documentation. The task remains `running`.

## Issues

- This is a local compatibility producer for globally equivariantly equivalent affine presentations. It does not yet construct arbitrary affine overlaps, open immersions, cocycles, or the global finite quotient.
- Hgraph still reports 585 pre-existing unattached Lean declarations.
- The final explicit Milne-path checkpoint is clean. Remaining workspace changes are concurrent or Horizon control-plane paths, so no unrelated files were committed.

## Why I stopped

The bounded verified unit is complete, and there are no additional authored Milne changes safe to commit in this one-shot run.

## Next

Advance `Milne.finite-quotient` through common affine overlap rings, open-immersion and cocycle data, then connect the local square to the global quotient and subsequent topology/sheaf/universal-property results.
